description: Central fine-tuning parameters for the unsignalised right-hand traffic give-way experiment. Scenario JSON keeps the route and traffic semantics; this file owns numeric parameters that may change between CARLA trials.

tuning_rationale.collision_d_min: Minimum additional clearance around the configured collision ellipse. Current value keeps the 20260619_203644 no-footprint-collision behavior while avoiding the overly conservative d_min=1.0/1.5 failures.
tuning_rationale.collision_ellipse_half_length: Ellipse half-length used by SMPC chance constraints; must cover the CARLA-like vehicle footprint plus margin.
tuning_rationale.collision_ellipse_half_width: Ellipse half-width used by SMPC chance constraints; must cover the CARLA-like vehicle footprint plus margin.
tuning_rationale.reference_regen_max_lateral_error: Guard for regenerating the local reference. After 2.5/4.0 allowed unsafe conflict-zone behavior in CARLA, the safety-first setting returns to the conservative 1.5m guard.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_enabled: Enables the prediction-gated rule-aware yielding state machine for the turning ego vehicle. The controller only activates yielding when an observed target has a valid multimodal prediction and that prediction indicates an oncoming conflict.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_speed: Near-stop target speed used in the hold_yield_line phase.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_decel: Maximum desired deceleration applied by the rule-aware yielding controller.
tuning_rationale.yield_conflict_radius: Radius around the fixed conflict point defined by the ego route and target current/predicted straight motion line.
tuning_rationale.yield_stop_buffer_distance: Distance before the fixed conflict point where the ego must wait while the straight-going target has priority.
tuning_rationale.yield_brake_distance_margin: Additional safety margin added to v^2/(2|a_min|) so yield activates before the ego reaches the physical braking limit for the stop point.
tuning_rationale.yield_wait_steer_lookahead_distance: Route lookahead from the stop point used to keep the ego aligned with the intended left turn while waiting.
tuning_rationale.yield_wait_steer_gain: Gain applied to the route-defined waiting steering command.
tuning_rationale.yield_ttc_margin: Time margin for deciding whether ego and target would overlap in the conflict zone.
tuning_rationale.yield_activation_distance: Maximum ego path distance to the conflict point at which the supervisor may activate.
tuning_rationale.yield_hold_distance: Distance close to the conflict point where the ego should continue holding until the target has cleared.
tuning_rationale.yield_release_time: Minimum predicted target-clearance time needed before releasing the near-stop hold.
tuning_rationale.yield_steer_damping: Steering damping factor applied while near-stopped so the ego does not keep turning sharply during the yield hold.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_enabled: Enables the released_recovery phase after the straight-going target has cleared the conflict zone.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_steps: Maximum number of controller steps in which the ego may recover from near-stop yielding.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_regen_period: Reference regeneration period during post-yield recovery. A shorter period helps the ego rebuild a feasible local reference after stopping.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_max_lateral_error: Temporary lateral-error guard used only after a completed yield, preventing stale-reference lock while still bounding recovery reference generation.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_speed: Minimum desired speed during post-yield recovery so the ego resumes the turn after safely yielding.
tuning_rationale.yield_recovery_accel: Minimum desired acceleration during post-yield recovery.
tuning_rationale.nominal_speed: Nominal unobstructed speed. The ego is allowed to slow down or nearly stop to yield to the straight-going target.
